As a timely response to COVID19 related restrictions an online knowledge and eservice platform was launched httpsruralcluster.org. It contains all training and marketing materials international standards export requirements document templates and etc which can be accessed change free. title.narrative: Farmers and forest users trained to upgrade to more sustainable NRM practices

description.narrative: At least 15 000 farmers and forest users trained via online by indirecly by using youtube channel and protal of the project on more sustainable NRM practices

comment.narrative: TBD
Calculation will be done based on the number of farmers and forest users signedvisit for online platform and youtube channel views.

Online platform established as credible learning and information center for farmers and forest users from 3 project countries and content is not limited by CA countries and applicable for other countries. Today approx. 230 practical trainings counted via online platform visits and downloads as well as facetoface meetings conducted within Farmer forest user Groups on sustainable NRM production of selected local agrifoods via applying newly gained experience and due to Covid19 restrictions most of the trainings were not possible but desipte it some facetoface meetings conducted. In order to reach out more stakeholders online tradeinfo portal promoted anyone can download any materials at any time which contains learning modules information about quality management NRM practices and requirements etc.More than 10 000 copies of brochures were distributed on nontimber forest products with elements of sustainable NRM and organic agriculture in all target regions among farmers private sector employers and other stakeholders during the last 25 years. ELSOFP keep collaborates with state agencies CSOs business structures regional and national projects and participated in their meeting and used their platform to distribute information also conducted joint trainings on quality management natural resource management entrepreneurship etc. As an example of collaboration with Ministry of Agriculture of Kyrgyz Republic in August 2021 during the two days of trainings ELSOFP could train more than 350 participants on NRM.

title.narrative: Farmers and forest users trained to upgrade to more sustainable NRM practices

description.narrative: At least 15 000 farmers and forest users trained via online by indirecly by using youtube channel and protal of the project on more sustainable NRM practices

comment.narrative: TBD
Calculation will be done based on the number of farmers and forest users signedvisit for online platform and youtube channel views.

Online platform established as credible learning and information center for farmers and forest users from 3 project countries and content is not limited by CA countries and applicable for other countries. Today approx. 230 practical trainings counted via online platform visits and downloads as well as facetoface meetings conducted within Farmer forest user Groups on sustainable NRM production of selected local agrifoods via applying newly gained experience and due to Covid19 restrictions most of the trainings were not possible but desipte it some facetoface meetings conducted. In order to reach out more stakeholders online tradeinfo portal promoted anyone can download any materials at any time which contains learning modules information about quality management NRM practices and requirements etc.More than 10 000 copies of brochures were distributed on nontimber forest products with elements of sustainable NRM and organic agriculture in all target regions among farmers private sector employers and other stakeholders during the last 25 years. ELSOFP keep collaborates with state agencies CSOs business structures regional and national projects and participated in their meeting and used their platform to distribute information also conducted joint trainings on quality management natural resource management entrepreneurship etc. As an example of collaboration with Ministry of Agriculture of Kyrgyz Republic in August 2021 during the two days of trainings ELSOFP could train more than 350 participants on NRM.

Total number of EU based traders at least 24 contracts to be signed

B2B with companies from Germany Latvia and Lithuania. In order to support farmers and forest users as well as processing enterprises in Kyrgyzstan Uzbekistan and Tajikistan the ELSOFP project funded by the EU and Central Asia V Invest program and the UNDP Central Asia Aid for Trade Project funded by the Government of Finland planned series of online business B2B meetings with buyers from Europe. Therefore In September 2021 ELSOFP and UNDP AFT continued their collaboration in Market Access Development to European Countries for local CA MSMEs products and shared registration invitation for 3 days B2Bs with 3 different buyers from Europe published via ELSOFP platform distributed via various partners trade associations communications channels.Why online format For purchasing organizations from Europe communication and trust play an important role in trade relations. The period of the pandemic showed that many negotiations and in general all workrelated issue took place remotely via online channels. Before making facetoface meetings and getting to know directly small farming forestry and processing enterprises it was necessary to make sure that B2B participants would not experience any difficulties in communication.In order to establish sustainable value chain development and avoid spam and opportunistic MSMEs participation in B2Bs was initiated twostep registrations. Producers individual entrepreneurs farmer cooperatives NWFP smallholderscollectors etc. wishing to take part in the B2B meetings had to follow one three registration links see below and fill in permanent trade portal registration form providing detailed information to the buyerstraders for current and future B2Bs The final lists of registered participants were formed by purchasing organizations from Europe and accordingly distributed via invitation links ZOOM. During the meetings the participants had the opportunity to present their products and company conduct business negotiations on export issues and establish business contacts with buyers from Europe. All together were planned 52 B2Bs in fact 48 B2Bs took place some of the manufacturers were unable to attend due to connection problems possible further cooperation is indicated as 31 65 success.B2B meetings for 2020 2021 facilitated the signing of contracts for the export of about 3000 tons of products from Central Asia see below other contracts are under negotiation due to COVID19 and the unproductive season of 2021 weather hazards.

300 online practical trainings face to face or via portal.

Today approx. 230 practical trainings counted via online platform visits and downloads as well as facetoface meetings conducted within Farmer forest user Groups on production of selected local agrifoods via applying newly gained experience through ToT approach due to Covid19 restrictions most of the trainings were not possible but desipte it some facetoface meetings conducted.
